entities.name: Rafiq
entities.description: The commander of the Knights of the Reliquary of Bant and its highest-ranked Sigiled.

entities.name: Knights of the Reliquary
entities.description: A knightly order of Bant commanded by Rafiq.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara whose champions settle conflict through ritualized duels.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of Alara whose forces fought Bant and which uses Etherium magic.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A shard of Alara where Rafiq rescued Levac and Salay.

entities.name: Mubin
entities.description: Rafiq's friend, mind-controlled by an Esper mage and paralyzed by Rafiq.

entities.name: Levac
entities.description: A person rescued from Grixis by Rafiq.

entities.name: Salay
entities.description: A person rescued from Grixis by Rafiq.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: A demon whose invasion force attacked Bant.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who gave Rafiq the Sword of Asha and wings of light. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Sword of Asha
entities.description: A legendary sword thrown to Rafiq by Elspeth Tirel.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The event bringing the shards of Alara together.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Sent Rafiq a message to employ the angels against the Phyrexians.

events.summary: Rafiq leads Bant's armies into a disastrous battle against Esper; Mubin is mind-controlled and Rafiq stabs him in the back, paralyzing him.
events.quote: Rafiq was forced to stab his old friend in the back, paralyzing him in the process.

events.summary: Rafiq rescues Levac and Salay from Grixis and fails to exorcise their zombified son.
events.quote: Rafiq managed to rescue Levac and Salay from Grixis

events.summary: Rafiq returns to Bant with Etherium and the rescued pair in time to warn of Malfegor's invasion.
events.quote: just in time to warn Bant of Malfegor 's invasion force

events.summary: Elspeth Tirel gives Rafiq the Sword of Asha and wings of light, and he slays Malfegor.
events.quote: Elspeth Tirel threw Rafiq the legendary Sword of Asha

events.summary: Tezzeret messages Rafiq to employ the angels against the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Tezzeret sent him a message to employ the angels against the Phyrexians .

relations.quote: Knight-General Rafiq was the commander of the Knights of the Reliquary from Bant .
Rafiq's friend Mubin was the victim of mind-controlling magic

relations.note: Slew the demon with two swings.
